thread:
sam: FYI console alert: a cluster of tenants show preview tokens >> ledger tokens starting ~07:12 UTC after we rolled route-mapping v2. No invoice anomalies yet but users will notice.

claire: saw that. Quick glance at preview stream shows duplicate increments for same external_id when both route_id and route_alias are present. preview-agg dedupe key only used route_id previously.

billng-bot: alert: preview_to_ledger_ratio high for tenants t-501,t-502,t-503 (ratio > 15)

tom: log snippet: `emit_preview(tenant=t-501, id=0x9f1, route_id=r-1, route_alias=alpha)` then `emit_preview(tenant=t-501, id=0x9f1, route_id=r-1, route_alias=null)` -> both recorded. dedupe_key currently `f"{id}:{route_id}"`.

ops-lee: short mitigations: 1) toggle route-mapping v2 -> fallback for affected tenants (fast) 2) patch preview-agg to include normalized alias in dedupe key 3) set console "hide-preview" for affected tenants until fixed. Prefer 2+3 if patch quick.

claire: patch is trivial: dedupe_key = f"{id}:{route_id}:{route_alias or 'none'}". Need to consider out-of-order arrival; dedupe window is 30s, maybe bump to 60s temporarily. Also add unit test for case alias present vs null.

tom: will add an integration test that simulates primary+shadow arrival order permutations. Also add a config flag to keep backward compatibility.

devex: UX ask: console quota card currently surfaces preview numbers without annotation. Can we add a small banner when preview ingestion schema mismatch detected: "Preview estimates may be temporarily inflated; final invoices unaffected." Also expose per-tenant toggle to hide preview.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0612-520 created (severity=P2). Assigned: sam (owner), tom (patch + PR), ops-lee (canary toggles), claire (recompute verification), devex (banner + hide-flag).

sam: timeline? If tom can PR in 90m we can canary to two preview shards and enable hide-flag for top tenants now.

ops-lee: applying hide-preview for t-501,t-502,t-503 now. Banner up. Monitoring dashboard `preview_minus_ledger_tokens` added for quick triage.

billng-bot: incident updated: preview_alerts suppressed for hidden-tenant list.

claire: recompute plan: run correction job for 07:00-07:30 window for impacted tenants after patch lands to refresh preview counts. I'll run ledger vs preview diff and post artifacts.

tom: PR filed https://gh/redwood/preview-agg/pull/2277 (feature-flagged). Includes unit tests for alias shapes and an integration test for arrival permutations. Bump dedupe window to 60s behind flag.

ops-lee: canary deployed to preview-shards [p-4,p-5]. Early metrics show preview delta dropping for a synthetic test tenant. Scheduling full rollout in 2h if green.

sam: good. Postmortem action: add rollout checklist item to validate preview-agg dedupe contract for any new routing metadata and add an automated staging compatibility test.

claire: note: final ledger unaffected because it dedupes at (external_id, tenant) and normalizes route metadata before aggregation. This is isolated to preview/console path.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0612-520 status -> in_progress

sam: leaving thread open until recompute and full rollout complete. Will draft a short postmortem after incident closes. Thanks all."
